comments.value: @{659f3f5cd27be2ec9467d3a2|full_name} There technicly only two players in VRC, Unity Video Player and AVPro, all udon video players are just controllers for those two, in case of iwaSync3 "Video" is Unity player and "Stream" is AVPro, its called that way because AVPro is only one supporting streams. Unity has build in fixed codecs, while AVPro uses Windows codec system and whatever you got installed on your OS, thats why AVPro deals with this better.
@{5ae4f9f6801fa451b10edafc|full_name} Great guidance! Thanks for helping my understanding for it.

comments.mergedPostDetails:
1. Open VRChat

2. Go to any world which uses iwaSync3 player to play videos

3. Videos give a loading error

4. LIVE content plays normally, VIDEO content does not.

5. Attempting to load same video URL (e.g., YouTube, Vimeo, etc.) on ProTV3 beta appears to function without issue.

6. Workaround: flagging VIDEO as type LIVE (even if not a live stream) will play the video correctly.

I believe something changed with the most recent VRChat update which broke the very popular and widely used iwaSync3 player from Hoshino Labs. Their most recent build of the player iwaSync3_v3.6.5 was released  recently. The developer, Hoshino Labs, (ikuko

@magi_ikuko on X/twitter) is aware of the issue. 

Quote:

現在VRChatの不具合でVideoのほうが正常に動作しなくなっています。

Liveのほうを選んでURLを頂ければ再生できる可能性がありますのでそちらでお試しいただければ幸いです。

If you select “Live” and input the URL, you may be able to play it!

I was able to reproduce this bug on both PCVR and Quest.

Meta PC app v.2024.2.3p2:1472-cd3e635c6e

Steam PC app v.2024.2.3 build 1470 (June21)

Meta Quest app (current public release, did not try beta)

A lot of these video players use unity for regular videos and avpro for live video. More generalized bug report:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/unity-video-player-cannot-play-youtube-videos-only-avpro-can-load-it
Same behavior here for USharpVideo. Switching it to stream mode by default fixed it for now.

VRChat requires an update to the new 

yt-dlp.exe version:

https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/tag/2024.07.25

with this version it will work!

If you download the exe and send the link manually with CMD, you will get a link in response that will work in VRChat:

You can do this manually as a workaround for all links...

load the EXE in C:\Downloads

open CMD

cd C:\Downloads

yt-dlp.exe --no-check-certificate --no-cache-dir --rm-cache-dir -f "(mp4/best)[height<=?1080][height>=?64][width>=?64][protocol^=http]" --get-url "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O4Yk5hYWpYA"

the response can be entered in VRChat in the player
Vimeo, niconico, etc all sites are not working
@{62df039bfa7fc344a0f910c7|full_name} "protocol^=http" will break the new 1080p support which doesn't run over http.
@{58de9f2a88e30448a5f75110|full_name} Do you have a recommended solution for this? The change needed in USharp? Some way to expose whether the default is video or stream in the editor?
@{62e1e57a8ec14e44acda4664|full_name} bottom of the component in the unity editor:  https://github.com/MerlinVR/USharpVideo/issues/87#issuecomment-2251557410
@{5d23cd6220d3ad1f2b3ee7b1|full_name} this ist the standard Unity video player request
We have updated yt-dlp, but we expect there may be issues coming up again in the future. For now this has been resolved at least in our testing.

@{62b61f8ec938a62475e4cd14|full_name} Shall we put our video players (like uSharpVideo) back on the standard Video mode? I noticed when making Stream mode as default, AV1 streams incurred a half-second hitch in performance every time the video changes. These performance issues are noticable and annoying, especially with more than one player on looped playlists. And this is on an RTX 4070 with dedicated AV1 decoding.
@{62e1e57a8ec14e44acda4664|full_name} We always recommend using AVPro as the video player backend, if you are experiencing different issues there please open a new canny.
